name: ask_secret
description: Ask the person for a secret, such as a bot token or an API key. Show the label, the help (markdown) and a masked field. Never put the value in the reply: post it to the console's secret endpoint (POST /api/wizards/threads/{sessionId}/secrets with the value), which answers with a handle, and reply with that handle. A reply holding anything but a handle is refused.

label.description: What the secret is, e.g. Bot token

submit.description: What the button sending it says, e.g. Next

handle.description: The handle the console's secret endpoint gave for the value
